method: Unmodified standard viewer Terrarium samples, bilinearly interpolated at pixel centers in the signed local bridge frame. No terrain flattening or fitting to the bridge. Grid spacing5m oversamples the coarse underlying DEM and does not imply5m survey accuracy.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Coarse mixed-source terrain, possibly affected by vegetation/buildings and interpolation. Model endpoint/pier heights are fitted approximately to this retained viewer terrain, not to surveyed as-built grades.
